headline: Medtronic (MDT) Stock May Be Fairly Valued As Shares Sit Near A 5 Year Low
summary: Medtronic stock is coming off a 5 year period where the share price has fallen about 25%, yet current checks suggest the shares sit close to their intrinsic value on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) basis and screen as undervalued on earnings multiples. That mix, alongside fresh moves in AI assisted surgery and pain management, leaves investors weighing whether the current price around US$84.22 offers enough compensation for the risks. headline: Is Medtronic (MDT) Fairly Valued After Its Pediatric Cannula Recall?
summary: Medtronic (MDT) is in focus after a voluntary Class II recall of its DLP One-Piece Pediatric Arterial Cannula, following two complaints about loose foreign material containing trace levels of blood. See our latest analysis for Medtronic. headline: Medtronic (MDT) Completes $650 Million SPR Deal And Launches ViaVerte
summary: Medtronic (NYSE:MDT) has completed its US$650m acquisition of SPR Therapeutics. The company formally launched the ViaVerte system at ASPN 2026, expanding its pain therapy portfolio. The deal adds a non opioid pain management platform to Medtronic’s existing medical device offerings. Medtronic is known for its broad medical device portfolio across cardiology, neurology and surgical care.
